handoff: Review #1: AC1-AC6 each proven at S1 (archive-ref.test.ts); archive push precedes every removal in GR6 and GR6b, failed push removes nothing and retries per tick; no base-tree runs/ reader left (D16); status item and doctor check point to norn upgrade. Tests not loosened, no new skips. 9 minor/nit findings (corrupt archive reads as empty, cache write can throw in loadSnapshot, test gaps for run view steps and GR6b failed push). Merge: keep one closeStory push with slice 09; slice 12's cache to be dropped for archivedRecordDir.

findings.title: A corrupt archive record silently reads as no run state and is re-unpacked on every snapshot
findings.detail:
archivedRecordDir returns null when unpackRecordSync fails, and runStateSource (run-state.ts runStateSource) falls back to the empty machine dir. run list then shows an empty story instead of a corrupt one (spirit of S2: never guess). There is no negative cache either, so every snapshot (status --segment every few seconds, HC13) stages and validates the record again.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Surface the unpack errors as the story's file errors (corrupt) and remember a failed sha, e.g. a marker in archive/<story>/.

findings.title: Archive cache write inside loadSnapshot can throw or race
findings.detail:
unpackRecordSync throws on a cat-file failure (for example a ref to a missing object). The concurrent unpack path swaps dest aside, and pruning other shas can remove a folder a concurrent reader still uses. All of this now runs inside loadSnapshot (observe, loadProjectView, the trace view), so an exception fails the whole tick or status. It follows the base-cache precedent (D6 allows the machine-dir cache), so it is not an H2 breach.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Catch in archivedRecordDir and return an error result; skip the swap when dest already exists (same sha = same content).

findings.title: Header says 'No writes, no network' but loadSnapshot may now unpack the archive cache
findings.detail:
The file header is stale after this change.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Reword it to name the machine-dir archive cache.

findings.title: run view on clone C asserts only story/run_id, not rounds and steps
findings.detail:
AC2 says run list and run view 'list every round and step'. Rounds and steps are asserted only for run list (lines 178-180).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Assert the run view's unit/step content too.

findings.title: D15 for GR6b: the record_push_failed path is untested
findings.detail:
D15 says 'GR6 and GR6b push the final record first ... A failed archive push leaves the cleanup owed and retried'. Only GR6's rejected push is tested. The close_story / story close record_push_failed branches (lifecycle.ts closeClosedIssueStory, story-close.ts) are never exercised. AC3 does not demand it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a rejected-archive case for GR6b mirroring AC1 (it may land with slice 09's reconciled closeStory push).

findings.title: After removal, doctor's exit code and absence of a FAIL line are not asserted
findings.detail:
Only run_state.ok true is checked.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Also assert that no 'run state' FAIL line is left.

findings.title: A run-id miss fetches archive refs for unfinished stories too, and an offline fetch is swallowed
findings.detail:
fetchArchived gets every snapshot story key, filtered only by machine-dir/local-ref presence. It is still one ls-remote plus one fetch. archive.ts fetchRecords(...).catch(() => []) makes an offline miss look like unknown_run.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Limit it to finished stories (status done/dropped), and mention a failed fetch in do_instead.

findings.title: Status names facts.repo.default_branch, doctor names the configured base_branch
findings.detail:
The two texts may name different branches when base_branch is set. doctor.ts runStateCheck also calls usableConfig(ctx) twice.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use one base name source.

findings.title: Import cycle run-state.ts <-> record-ref.ts
findings.detail:
run-state imports archivedRecordDir from record-ref, which imports storyRunStateDir from run-state. It works in ESM, but it is a smell.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move archivedRecordDir or inject it.
